text:
elaine.wu: BridgePay requested a 4-week pilot for a payments fraud assistant + agent scripts. Kickoff Mon 11am PT. Need POC scope: success criteria, golden prompt bank, scoring rubric, regression gates, infra options, and security/pricing blockers. Who can take the harness?

omar.reyes: I can build the harness and author the initial golden set. Need 30-60 anonymized transcripts and a prioritized list of fraud scenarios. Also need their expected SLAs (p95/p99 latency, target throughput).

tony.li: I'll handle scoring and infra sizing. Quick notes: hosted eval (sampled replay) cheaper; VPC/Dedicated for live traffic. Ballpark pilot costs: hosted eval ~$7-12k for 4 weeks; dedicated trial footprint ~$20-35k/mo equivalent depending on commit.

claire.bates: Security checklist: confirm masking strategy for PII, retention window, customer-managed KMS requirement, and whether they need HSM. SQ due before EOW next week.

secops-bot: SQ template v2 is at https://redwood/sq-templates. Post draft to #eng-security for review. HSM requirement triggers Private path and ~3 week onboarding delta.

omar.reyes: Proposed success metrics: Top1 fraud precision >= 86%, FPR <= 3.5%, p95 latency < 350ms on their VPC, and no high-risk SQ findings. Also add regression gate: no >5% relative drop on golden set overall score after model/prompt changes.

elaine.wu: Good. For golden prompts seeds (we'll expand to ~200):
G-01: "Customer reports two declined transactions in different states within 10 mins; summarize fraud indicators and recommend next action."
G-02: "Given tx attributes {amount, merchant, device_age, velocity}: classify FRAUD/OK and list top 2 signals."
G-03: "Write a short agent script (2 questions) to verify a disputed charge."

omar.reyes: Scoring rubric (automated + human sample): Label correctness (0-3), Explanation quality (0-2), Actionability (0-2), Hallucination risk (0-1). Total 0-8. Pass = 6+. Auto-score label + embedding-sim similarity; fallback to human if confidence < threshold.

tony.li: Infra: if they plan 40 TPS sustained, spikes 150 TPS -> recommend Dedicated pool with autoscale buffer (~5 A100 equiv). If they only share samples for offline replay, we can run on-hosted with smaller footprint. I'll produce a short cost delta table.

claire.bates: Ask BridgePay: are dev logs allowed masked and retained <30 days? Do they require PCI-specific controls or SOC2 addenda? Get answers pre-kickoff.

omar.reyes: Regression plan: nightly automated run on golden set; open alert if total score drops >5% absolute OR Label correctness drops >6% relative. Human review required to approve rollback or prompt/model tweak. We'll snapshot goldens + scoring config (sha256) to detect edits.

elaine.wu: Agenda for Mon: 1) confirm golden dataset ownership and transfer method; 2) security & masking rules; 3) deployment preference + SLA targets; 4) pricing options; 5) success metrics & regression gating.

elaine.wu: Action items: - @elaine.wu request 50 sample transcripts + fraud taxonomy by Thu EOD - @tony.li share cost ballpark by Thu noon - @claire.bates highlight mandatory SQ fields by Thu noon - @omar.reyes create golden seeds skeleton by Fri

secops-bot: Note: if customer requests customer-managed KMS/HSM, escalate to eng-security and sales — Private onboarding adds timeline and checklist.

omar.reyes: One more: tag each golden with expected label, severity (low/med/high), adversarial flag. That helps weighted sampling and regression sensitivity.

elaine.wu: Great. I'm sending invites and the pre-kickoff checklist now. Thanks team :raised_hands:
